review.notes: Full review. Sources: both cited texts fetched from the authors' pages and all 51 locators read at the text (34 Bishop and Peres draft of 1 December 2015, 17 Hutchinson 1981 retyped), including the 15 sampled sections. Adversarial pass over every statement, Check and proof sketch with computed values (numerical Checks recomputed: 71 and 148 points for the harmonic set, 33 for the squares, 34 words and bound 64.04 for ratios (1/2, 1/4)). One finding (P2): the potential bound in the converse bullet of 3.3 is false for the normalised measure (K = [0, 1/10], s = 1: 1 against 1/4). One small correction: the Frostman route of 3.2 uses positivity of the Hausdorff content without naming it as an input. Library: 63 cited Mathlib names elaborated with #check at the pin, none unknown; no duplicate of the roadmap's objects in Mathlib, Tau Ceti, main or the open roadmap pull requests. Suggested.lean elaborates with 26 sorry warnings only; one-tactic probe closed 0 of 26 theorems; all summary headlines are stated. Automatic checks all passed; dependency check: 0 problems, Mathlib-only. Pull request text agrees with the head; no change outside the folder. For the human reviewers: the main source is a 2015 draft of a since-published book.
